title: Not the scent it says
text: Not the scent it says. This is a nice size candle. The box is very sturdy so it would be nice for gift giving. The description describes this as a pine scent but the label says" Cinnamon, clove and Christmas tree. The first two scents are so strong I cant smell the tree. If you like the other scents then you will love this one. I dont.
